Website design / Source reviewed

Get your agent ready for website design.

Turn a rough idea into one focused page. Start with a clear brief, then improve the result in small passes.

You will make: a local one-page prototype with a useful headline, one main action and a mobile layout.

Before you start: a Windows or macOS computer, a browser, eligible Claude Code access and text/images you own. Account cost and usage limits depend on your plan.

Step 01

Open one practice folder

Use the official Claude Desktop setup. Install the app for your computer, sign in with eligible access and open the Code tab. Choose a new local folder such as website-practice. Existing users can start here. Check current access and cost before subscribing.

Ready when: you have completed this step and checked the result before continuing.

If this step does not work

Recheck the requirements and the exact file or account you selected. Keep your original unchanged; use the guide's fix or undo advice.

Step 02

Give it direction

Paste the brief below into your session. Replace the brackets. Attach your own logo or screenshots you have permission to use. Describe what you like about a reference; ask for an original design.

Ready when: you have completed this step and checked the result before continuing.

If this step does not work

Recheck the requirements and the exact file or account you selected. Keep your original unchanged; use the guide's fix or undo advice.

Step 03

Build the useful part first

Ask for a static index.html using plain HTML and CSS, with no packages or external services. Review the proposed sections before building. Keep the first version to one page and one primary action.

Ready when: you have completed this step and checked the result before continuing.

If this step does not work

Recheck the requirements and the exact file or account you selected. Keep your original unchanged; use the guide's fix or undo advice.

Step 04

Check, then polish

Open index.html in your browser. Narrow the window and tab through links. Check readable text, visible focus, working anchors and your main action. Ask for one repair pass with the actual problems you found. Add motion only when it clarifies feedback, with a reduced-motion option.

Ready when: you have completed this step and checked the result before continuing.

If this step does not work

Recheck the requirements and the exact file or account you selected. Keep your original unchanged; use the guide's fix or undo advice.

Stuck? If Code is unavailable, check account eligibility in the official setup guide. If the page fails, share the browser error and expected result. To undo, keep wanted files and delete the practice folder.

Copy this starter brief

Create an original one-page website for [audience] who need [outcome].
Main action: [one action]. Sections: introduction, benefits, example, FAQ, final action.
Style: [three concrete traits]. Use my supplied content; mark missing facts as TODO.
First propose two visual directions and ask only questions that block the build.
Then make index.html with plain HTML/CSS and minimal JavaScript. No packages,
tracking, network calls, accounts or deployment. Use system fonts and owned assets.
Make it readable on phones, keyboard usable and respectful of reduced motion.
Report what you checked and what I still need to check.
Source, requirements & limits

Adapted from Metics Media, Build $10,000 Websites using Claude Code (Ultimate Guide): brief and references at 06:02; review and polish at 15:54; mobile pass at 20:52. 1,308,220 views checked 14 November 2026; highest-viewed website tutorial in our five-result shortlist.

This is our original simplified workflow. It uses pasted project context. The source's global skill installs, external components and paid hosting are outside this guide. English captions were reviewed; sampled frames were unavailable after media retrieval stalled. Subscription cost and usage vary; no installation, generated website, usability benefit, commercial value or revenue was tested here. Official desktop instructions checked 14 November 2026.
